name: Spider-Man Desk
look: A frame from the 1960s Spider-Man cartoon. Spider-Man sits behind a big wooden office desk with a black desk phone and papers, in a plain teal room with a blue armchair, while a framed portrait of Spider-Man himself hangs on the wall.
use: Used for office and work jokes: Spider-Man sits at his desk as a boss, an employee or someone waiting by the phone, with a caption about work, being busy or pretending to be important.
examples: Hanging a portrait of my boss in the office
describe: spiderman sitting at an office desk with a phone
